collection.description: A builder pauses to admire work completed over several days.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a builder, pauses to admire work completed over several days. The afternoon feels unusually long, despite the simple work.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a builder, pauses to admire work completed over several days. (Name1) decides not every day has to be remarkable.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a builder, pauses to admire work completed over several days. The worry remains, but it seems smaller after a quiet break.
